name: Winthrop Technology
summary: UWA's Western Australian Regional Computing Centre (WARCC, 1972) renamed and spun off as Winthrop Technology ~1992; commercial computing-services company (lineage continues as Winthrop Australia). NOT related to Westnet (a separate Geraldton-founded ISP, 1994, -> iiNet 2008) (ALPHAWEST SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 009 196 347).

events.details: WARCC renamed Winthrop Technology and spun off from UWA.
Acquired by AlphaWest / Comswest International — Winthrop Technology pages replaced by Comswest by Dec 1998.

refs.label: Still branded Winthrop Technology (a division of AlphaWest) in Feb 1998.
By Dec 1998 wt.com.au serves Comswest; later WestNet and a 404.
ABR: ALPHAWEST SERVICES PTY LTD ACN 009 196 347
